requirements.text: Produce the nearest lexicographically greater arrangement when it exists.
Preserve the complete multiset of values and array length.
Wrap a maximal arrangement to the smallest ascending arrangement.
Modify the caller-held array, including duplicate and singleton cases.

reference_complexity.auxiliary_space: O(1) auxiliary space, excluding stored input and serialized output
reference_complexity.notes: Reference guidance, not an assessment of submitted source. Include stored input, serialized output, returned arrays, and stacks in total space. In-place/constant-space compliance is reviewed manually under Technical Quality; no automatic memory or complexity score is added. Difficulty follows LeetCode and the suggested practice duration is provisional.
